        ll sum1 = comb[v1][R];
        ll cur2 = comb[v2][R] - comb[v2 - 1][R];
        dfs(x + sum1 * cur2, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    if (v1 >= R) {
        ll cur1 = comb[v1][R] - comb[v1 - 1][R];
        ll sum2 = comb[v2][R];
        dfs(x, y + cur1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
    }

        ll sum2 = comb[v2][R];
        res += solve(x, y + cur1 * sum2, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    return res;
}
